title: Chitosan–cellulose hydrogels: advances in stimuli-responsive biomedical therapeutics
content:

Chitosan–cellulose hydrogels are versatile stimuli-responsive biomaterials for therapeutics, combining chitosan's antimicrobial, mucoadhesive, pH-sensitive properties with cellulose's strength, water retention, and biodegradability.
